representation_plans.learner_operation: Trace attended model behavior, observed consequence or emotion, and the observer’s later response without collapsing them into one mechanism.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List model action, visible consequence, observer attention, emotional response, and later behavior in sequence.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Choose the bounded mechanism statement that fits the observed modeling and vicarious evidence.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State model behavior, observer response, and available neural or emotional evidence without naming a sole cause.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Evaluate attention to the model, observed consequence, capability, and opportunity before predicting behavior.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List model similarity or status, action, consequence, observer capability, and later opportunity in order.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Predict whether the observer is more or less likely to reproduce the modeled behavior under the stated conditions.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State model features, consequence, and observer conditions without supplying the prediction.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Select the model whose premises match message elaboration or reciprocal person-behavior-environment processes.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List motivation, ability, argument quality, cues, self-efficacy, model behavior, and environment under separate headings.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Generate the model-consistent prediction after one message-processing or social-cognitive condition changes.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State message, audience, model, efficacy, behavior, and environment facts without labeling a route or theory.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Classify each manipulated variable as behavior, message, target, or social and predict its directional effect.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List the four factor classes with the case variable and attitude result in an accessible table.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Compare conditions and attribute a bounded attitude prediction to the manipulated factor or stated interaction.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State factor levels, group characteristics, and attitude scores in a table without highlighting the stronger condition.
